axis: An axis is the imaginary line that an object spins around. This is the middle of the circle of the turn, and at a right angle to it.
The Earth rotates once a day on its axis.
The second cervical vertebra of the spine.
axe: An axe is a tool made from a short blade on a long handle. Axes are often used to cut wood.
If you axe something, you chop it with an axe.
If you axe something, you end or reduce it in a sudden or mean way.
The government announced its plans to axe public spending.
If you axe someone, you fire a person from their job.
He got axed in the last round of firings.
axiology: Axiology is the field of study in philosophy that studies ethical and aesthetic values.
axle: An axle is the pin or spindle on which a wheel revolves, or which revolves with a wheel.
An axle is a transverse bar or shaft connecting the opposite wheels of a vehicle.
axel: An axel is a jump that includes one or more complete turns and a half turn while in the air.
axil: An axil is the upper angle between a leaf and a stem.
axiom: An axiom is an established principle or statement which is universally accepted.
axiomatic: If something is axiomatic, it is unquestionable.
